description.text: Written by Deacon Mihret Melaku from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, this book dives into the differences between Orthodox Christianity and Protestantism, particularly in the fields of scripture, the saints, iconography, salvation, the sacraments, and the church. Deacon Mihret presents scriptural, patristic, and historical evidence to show the Orthodox Church is justified to holding onto the faith preserved for 2,000 years.
